Algebra 1 · Unit 6: Exponents and Exponential Relationships

Scientific Notation

Write very large and very small numbers as a × 10ⁿ, and compute with them.

What you’ll learn

  • Convert between standard and scientific notation
  • Multiply and divide in scientific notation
  • Compare quantities in scientific notation

Learning activities

Interactive lab · from Algebra 1: Exponent Rules

Project Evolve

The MTB Innovation Lab: help a fictional bike company take a new gravity bike from prototype to used market. Simplify scaling expressions with the exponent rules, handle huge test datasets and tiny measurements in scientific notation, model a launch waitlist growing 20% a month, and track the bike’s modeled resale value as it decays, estimating targets from tables (no logarithms).

Level
Beginner to Advanced
Time
35-50 min
  • 4 stages
  • CAD scaling lab
  • Factor board
  • Test rig and converter
  • Launch growth tracker
  • Resale value simulator
  • MTB Product Innovation Certification (12)
  • Product Lifecycle Report

Practices here: Convert between standard and scientific notation; Compare quantities in scientific notation; Multiply and divide in scientific notation

Opens at: Stage 2: Engineering Test Lab · or start from the beginning
